transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because it’s gotten kind of out of hand with wasps. I plan my whole summer around trying to avoid them. I’ve even stopped doing the garden work I used to help with at church, and if I hear buzzing near the back porch, I make my husband unload things instead of going out there myself.
Is your anxiety mainly about wasps, or do you find yourself worrying a lot about many other things too?

It’s mainly wasps. I mean, I know they’re small and other people can just swat them away, but for me, if one gets close, it feels like something really bad is about to happen. I don’t sit around worrying like that about everything.
